fold_system.name: Folding: Same Faces, Only Positions Change
fold_system.description: Seven fold primitives demonstrating the universal transformation principle. Deltahedron nets, helix coils, pineapple cylinders, Fibonacci spirals, origami birds, curtain walls, and flocking inflation. Same vertices, same faces throughout — only positions change.
learning_objectives: See fold_amount drive geometry from 0 to 1 across seven primitive types
Verify same vertex and face count at every fold stage
Compare net folding, helix coiling, hinge cascading, and vertex flocking
Understand Cauchy's rigidity theorem through deltahedra
Experience Transformer-style activation windows on the origami bird
